insight: The tech industry is shifting from treating AI as an experimental feature to making it the fundamental core of business models, operations, and product strategy. While this transition is driving significant investment and job growth in hardware and specialized software, it is also raising new questions about industrial sovereignty and regulatory compliance. Companies are now focused on building sustainable, value-driven AI businesses that integrate deeply with global infrastructure and security protocols.
